balls.text: holes out to long-on! It's another three-for for Harshal. Full dipping slower ball outside off, he waits and has a slog, but can only get height on this and not a lot of distance
full and into the stumps, has a quick whip at it and sends it straight to deep midwicket in the deep. Not out, of course, because it's a free hit, but they only run a single
high full toss as a slower yorker goes wrong. It's off stump line but he has to duck to let that go. Free hit

run-out chance at the non-striker's end after Rashid clatters a back-foot shot into it. Slower ball, short of a length and at off stump, pulled into the stumps and Holder is running. The ball rolls out on the pitch and Holder now has to run back. Harshal grabs the ball in one hand and pulls a stump out with the other. But Holder is back in
full and just outside off, driven to long-off's left
full offcutter outside off, reaches out and has a slog, well beaten on the inside edge
yorker at off stump, opens the face and slices it straight to Kohli at point. Gives up the run but Kohli misses at the non-striker's end
nails the yorker outside off once again. Lovely execution this. Rashid has a chop and can't get bat on it
full and dipping slower ball outside off, hangs back and has a slash, beaten
yorker at the stumps, jammed out to extra cover's left
yorker at off stump, whippy shot once again, only a yard to extra cover's right
slower short ball outside off, waits on it this time and plays a late upper cut, carves it over point
slower yorker outside off, hangs back in the crease and looks to bring out the helicopter. It comes off the thick inside edge and trickles pitch side
yorker nailed at off stump, can only push it back down the pitch
and another! Good length offcutter outside off, Holder reaches out and has a stab at it with an angled bat. Gets a thick inside edge past short fine
full dipping slower ball, waits on it and flicks out to deep square
yorker length at middle stump, jammed down to long-on

taken at long-off! Outfoxes him with the offcutter again, but this time has him hitting it where he wants. This is closer to off stump, Saha gets more of the middle of the bat on it, but has no timing as he tries to go over extra cover. It lobs harmlessly for AB coming in from long-off
full slower ball outside off, reaches out and looks to drive firmly through extra cover. Gets a thick inside edge past the keeper
legcutter, good length and gripping outside off. He hangs leg side of it and tries to chop it fine of short third. Beaten
good length and slow, angled into the stumps. Gets forward and turns it into the leg side off the front foot
good length and just outside off, jabbed pitch side on the off side before he refuses a run
short of a length and just outside off, opens the face and punches it to backward point's left. A tumbling stretch there but can't gather cleanly as they take a run
through short fine! Full and into leg stump, stands tall and has a flick at it. Chahal dives to the right at short fine and ultimately right over it
legcutter at a length outside off, waits on that and pats it into the covers from the crease

legbreak, dipping and turning from off stump. Can only get forward and push this to extra cover's left. Kohli there unleashes a needless throw and the ball ricochets off the striker's stumps for an overthrow
another googly, full and at off stump. Waits on that and expertly closes the face to push it delicately into the vacant leg side for a double
good length at leg stump, gets forward and flicks to deep backward square
googly, tucks him up at leg stump, gets deep in the crease and whips it to deep square
googly turns down leg side from a length, he gets deep in the crease and clips it towards deep square

Kohli reviews an lbw. And this looks pretty close. Unless that's a googly. It doesn't look like it is. It's pushed through quick, a legbreak from leg stump that Samad looks to sweep and catches on the back thigh. This will come down to whether it pitched in line. And Samad's in trouble if it did...it did! It's three wickets in seven balls for RCB, and two of them big-hitters

grabs it in the follow-through! Legcutter floated full and just outside off. Roy waits on it and absolutely drills it back at Christian, who has barely any time. Sticks his hands out as the ball is headed for his right thigh, and manages to get enough on it to keep it within his grasp. That allows him to take it with a bit of a juggle
legcutter, short of a length and wide outside off. Reaches out and toe-ends the cut to extra cover
short of a length just outside off, hangs back and chops that to sweeper's left
good length at off stump, patted firmly from the crease, bounces over the bowler and to mid-off
short of a length at middle stump, pulled off the front foot to deep midwicket

straight to deep midwicket. Short of a length and cramps him at a middle stump line as he takes a step down and then a big one across to set up for the pull shot. It hits him high on the bat and AB runs in a small distance to take it inside
tossed up at leg stump, driven against the turn to long-on
good length and pushed through flatter. He steps out and is late on the on-drive, thick inside edge onto pad
short of a length and skidding on at middle stump, pulled to short fine's left

Roy reviews a catch behind. Good length and turning away from outside off, looks to bring out the reverse sweep and is given caught behind as it pops up off his arm. He reviewed right away. And replays suggest it was off the forearm...there is teensy little murmur on Ultra Edge but nothing of consequence as it goes past the bat. Decision overturned
full at off stump, driven with the turn down to long-off

launched over long-on! This is full and at middle stump, he steps to the pitch of it - and that is key, because the ball doesn't turn after he's got too close to heave at this. And Christian is backpedaling at long-on so he clears him
good length and onto leg stump, a legcutter. Clips it straight to short fine
good length and in at the stumps, gets forward and pushes to midwicket
short of a length and just outside off, waits on that and opens the face to dab that to third man's right and they sneak a second
short of a length at off stump, shuffles and pulls to deep midwicket
good length and into middle stump, shuffles and hits this leg glance straight to short fine
good length at middle stump, plants the front leg across and flicks out to towards deep square
full and into the pads this time and he hangs deep in the crease and tickles it fine
full slower ball at middle stump, watches that on and flicks to deep backward square
good length outside off, gets forward and drives to sweeper cover's right

knocks the top of middle! Another offcutter landed perfectly at a good length, coming in from off stump. Williamson backs away, opens up his stance and extends the arms to try and loft it over extra cover. But that has gripped as he takes a bet on it being regular-paced. It is not, it cuts back in and kisses the inside edge before hitting the top of the stumps
high-ish full toss at off stump, backs away and tucks it between deep square and deep midwicket to steal two
lands safely again! Offcutter at a length outside off. Roy makes room and looks to punch this over cover but the offcutter grips and gets big and he checks his shot. Lands safely in front of long-off
good length and tight at the off stump, blocked into the covers
lobbed up wide outside off and turning away as he brings out the reverse sweep. Top-edged to short third's left
full at leg stump, gets forward and clips to deep midwicket
good length at middle stump, punched to deep midwicket
good length and skidding onto the pads, gets deep and tickles it fine of short fine
short of a length at middle stump, backs away for a hurried pull to long-on
leading edge, but short of Chahal! Full ball on off, as Williamson mistimes his flick to the on side
good length ball outside off, and slower too. Pushed to long-on from deep in his crease
bowls fuller on middle and leg, as Roy flicks that to deep midwicket. The collection by Maxwell there is not clean, and so that is two runs
quicker and fuller on off. Comes on with the arm, as he dabs that to point
pulls this good length ball outside off between long-on and deep midwicket. The former runs to his right and slides to stop that
short and wide of off, and cut away between point and short third man! Swings his arms full stretch to that, and finally finds the fence

lands just short of short third man! This is again short of a length and wide of off, and turning further away from Roy. He still goes for the slash, but gets a top edge to escape yet again in the over
fuller on off, and he opens the bat face to tap that to point. A sharp single is completed, as Kohli throws to the keeper, who whips off a stump, but Roy was in. That's the fifty stand too
bowls short on off again, and Williamson cuts to the left of deep point. Two runs grabbed
leading edge, but lands way ahead of long-off! Looks to clobber that full ball on off to the on side, but the ball seemed to have come to him later than anticipated
goes short of a length just outside off. Cut away to deep point
good length ball on middle, and with a hint of turn after pitching. Defended back to the bowler
back of a length and a touch wide of off. Clipped to long-on for a single, with just three of that over
pushed off the outside half of the bat and aerially to cover, as Chahal goes full and outside off
skips down to this full ball on middle and off, and the ball hits his front pad as he tries to block. Chahal appeals half-hearted for leg before, but not given
this one turns away from him after pitching full outside off. Tapped with the open face of the bat to short third man
laps this full ball on off behind the wicket to fine leg after going down on his back knee. Quick two is gobbled
tosses it up to go full and outside off. He dabs it back off the inside half of the bat, with the ball turning into him
another one with a change of pace. This is full on middle and leg, and Williamson flicks that late to deep square leg
good length ball on off, and punched to long-on aerially
low full-toss outside off, but Roy is down the track early to this slower ball, as the ball takes the to end of his bat to go on the bounce to the keeper
good length ball on off, and angling into Roy. Tapped to point. He wanted a single, but was sent back by Williamson
pulled to deep midwicket! Harshal bowls short of a length on off, and Roy clubs that powerfully in the gap between deep square and long-on. Midwicket dives to his right, but can't get a hand
full delivery a touch wide of off, and driven with the full face of the bat to deep point after playing away from his body. The man there runs to his right to cut that off
fuller ball on off, and flicked toward midwicket to raise the side's fifty
good length ball on leg, and he misses his clip with his front leg outside leg. Strikes his pad too, and trickles to the off side
short of a length on leg, and pulled to deep square leg! Stays deep in his crease, and hammered away for four
full again on off, and clipped to midwicket. Shahbaz runs to his right to stop that
fuller on off, and straighter. Blocked back off the front foot
goes to sweep this full ball outside off, but the ball takes his bottom edge to roll over toward square leg

clips this good length ball outside leg, and times that brilliantly for another four! Short fine leg was inside the circle, and Williamson beats him to his left. Siraj runs to his right and dives to try and cut that off, but he's a little late to that
pretty full on off, and heaved across the line to long-on
fuller and wide of leg again. A slower ball too, as it dies to Bharat after Roy lets that go
good length ball on leg, and climbing on to the batter. Clipped to fine leg with a skip in his crease
firm drive from Williamson again! That was in the air for a moment, but he plays with the full face of the bat to this full ball in the slot on off, beating mid-off to his left
goes on a good length and wide of leg. Wide ball
nudges that fullish ball on middle with his bottom hand off again, as he gets a single to long-on

full-toss slightly wide of off, and Roy reaches out for it without foot movement to push that wide of mid-off! His bottom hand comes off as he plays that, with the ball coming off the bottom of the bat. Still enough force to send that between cover and mid-off inside the circle
this is shorter on length on middle, and doesn't quite take off. Roy pulls to deep midwicket from deep in his crease
fuller and outside leg, driven back off the full face of the bat
backs away to cut this short ball on middle, but cuts right to point
fuller on off, and just clipped toward midwicket. Takes a hurried single, as Shahbaz gives the chase to his right
pulls his length back to go on a good length on middle. Punched to long-off
bowls pretty full on middle, and that is driven back to the left of the bowler

pulled to deep square leg! Siraj goes short of a length on off, and Williamson swivels to pull that all the way  in huge gap available, with his front leg a touch in the air and his back leg outside off. Firmly placed that one
well stopped by Kohli to his right at cover! Again looks to push at that full ball outside off, but checks his shot rather late there

beats mid-off with a wonderful drive! Simply presents the full face of the bat to this full ball outside off, which is bowled with a scrambled seam. He places that to the left of mid-off, and gets an early four
comes down a step to this good length ball on off, but gets an inside edge to square leg as he looks to block
continues bowling a touch back of a length just outside off. Tapped to point off his front foot
gets a faint inside edge on to his back thigh, with the ball rolling down to his pad. Another good length ball on off, as he looks to dab at that close to his body
bowls on a good length on leg, and that keeps angling down for a wide
pushes at this very full ball on off to mid-off with the full face of the bat

taken at mid-on! Again goes to lift that full delivery on middle, but ends up skying it right where Maxwell stood. He looked to clip that, but instead got a leading edge there. Early wicket for Royal Challengers

difficult catch dropped by Siraj at fine leg! He had to run pretty far to his left and also dive, as the ball dropped out of his hands after he stretched them out. It was a full delivery on middle and leg, and Abhishek simply whipped that off his wrists as it made a good sound off the bat too
full delivery on middle, and flicked to the man at midwicket
just clears the long-off rope! This is right in the slot on a full length on off, and he swings hit bat after opening the bat face by staying deep in his crease and with his front leg on leg stump
low full-toss on middle, and clipped to deep midwicket! That came off the bottom of the bat, but was placed well above the fielder's head who was inside the circle

There is a throw at the bowler's end, but Roy is already in, and that ricochets off the stumps to allow an overthrow. Siraj goes back to that good length ball on off, and that is nudged to cover by Abhishek off the full face of the bat
drives at this fuller ball outside off, but not quite from the middle of the bat. Finds the man at cover-point as the bat slightly turns in his hands
good length ball on off at 140kph, and tapped back to the bowler with his head right down
and again. This is full and wide of off as well, and Abhishek doesn't want to go after that either
goes fuller and a touch wide of off. Abhishek shoulders arms to let that go, with the ball being in and around that typical Test-match length
starts with one on a good length on off, which is angling in. Clipped to the right of mid-on for a single to get off the mark

another wide full toss and again AB can't get it away! Bhuvi knows something we don't. Full and wide thrice to AB in this last over and for only one run. He gets a decent connection on this again, but they had deep extra cover placed exactly for that shot. Not that it would have mattered, this wasn't hit well enough
misses out on a full toss! It's a high full toss too, knee height, with lots of width. AB can only drive it on the bounce to extra cover
drills it over the bowler's head! Bhuvi misses by an inch, AB sends him miles! Driving length at off stump, AB dreams of that ball. And it comes at the perfect time, he pummels it over the bowler
smears the full toss straight to sweeper and refuses the run. It was outside off, and he got sweet connection, but not wide enough to contemplate a second
full and wide outside off, across him again and this time he manages to get bat on ball on the slash. It bounces out to sweeper cover
beaten on the slash! Slower ball at a length, wide outside off. He lines it up on the back knee and has a big slash at it. It's over his bat and bounces to the keeper. No attempt at a run

AB misses and Holder does superbly to get to the ball before RCB can think of a single. It's full outside off, AB shuffles and gets on his back knee to try and scoop him over short fine. He's managed to turn it into a full toss but swings through too soon and this jams between his right knee and the pitch. Holder is onto that quickly to keep AB at that end
another slower ball, dug in short and going away from middle and off. Looks to pull and ends up slicing it feebly into the square leg region

taken at midwicket! Slower ball again, dug in short and climbing in the corridor. He jumps into the line of that and has a big hoick at it. Gets it off the sticker of the bat and it's a simple one for Williamson to his left

oh keep this one in mind if this match gets tight n about ten minutes. It's a slower ball, short and cutting a long way past Shahbaz outside off. He shuffled but this kept going away and he left it. Not a wide, deems the umpire
full slower ball at middle stump, mistimed slog past midwicket at catchable height. Deep square cleans up to the right

Bhuvneshwar puts one down! Oh boyyyy. Right at him at sweeper cover. This is full, offcutter outside off. He steps out and has a slice at it this away from the body. Bhuvi moves a touch to his left and brings out the reverse cup, but that slips out
full and wide outside off, driven on the rise to sweeper cover
gets it over point! Low full toss outside off, gets down on one knee and opens the face late to get it right where he wanted it
good length and tight into the body, watchfully pushed to midwicket
short and just outside off, looks for the pull and gets an inside edge onto this pad. AB calls through for the run
good length outside off, driven on the rise into the covers
short and into middle stump, swivels and puts his first ball away over midwicket with a pull

shot! Puts the pressure right back on SRH and closes off Rashid's spell with a four. This is full and just outside off, gets forward to reach it and uses the pace to get the reverse sweep into the open point region

holes out to deep midwicket to end an innings he will like to forget quickly. It didn't come off, not even a little, today for Padikkal. Nice of his team-mates to clap for him as he gets back into the dugout. Rashid was toying with him, first googlies, then short ball, just inviting him to have a hit. Then he cramped him with a skidder at length and Padikkal's big pull wasn't big enough

bowled from well behind the crease as he gets this full and dipping rapidly on AB. He's shaped to sweep but the ball has landed quicker than he expected and he gets a thick inside edge on it, out to deep square
good length outside off, steps out and has a slash at it away from his body. Thick inside edge down to long-on
short and turning in from outside off, backs away and cuts to sweeper's left. He puts in a slide there, Roy to his left, and keeps him on strike
full and tight at middle stump, gets low and plays a very very risky sweep right off the crease to deep square
good length at off stump, gets forward and punches it down to long-off
mistimed slice to sweeper's right. Short of a length and climbing outside off, looks to slap it over extra cover off the front foot but it gets big on him
short of a length and across the corridor, hangs back and opens the face to run it down to third man
short of a length just outside off, arches and punches out to sweeper cover
short at leg stump, looks to pull and gets a leading edge towards point. AB calls for a tight run and makes it comfortably as the throw fizzes past him
good length at leg stump, gets stuck in the crease as he looks to flick, it rolls down the pitch
short and turning in from wide outside off has a cut and gets an inside edge that goes straight into Saha's shin region
full and just outside off, looks to drive and gets it into the pitch. Rashid catches it at the other end and appeals. They sent it upstairs and a clear bump ball is confirmed
reverse sweep and a well connected one at that. A bit of a panic shot, but it's come off nicely. Full and at the stumps, a googly, and he gets it quickly past point
beats the outside edge. Lovely googly, landing on a length outside off and drawing him into the drive
googly, full and just outside off. Gets low and sweeps it firmly to deep square

they've got Maxwell! Direct hit from Williamson! Poor cricket from RCB. This is a googly, sliding away from off stump. Padikkal with a tentative poke off the back foot, into the covers. Williamson is very close in at extra cover and swoops down on it to his right before letting the throw out. Hits the base of Padikkal's off stump and Maxwell is nowhere near making his ground. No run there at all
slower short ball at middle stump, pulled firmly out to deep midwicket

nearly takes out his fingers. Full slower ball at off stump. Maxwell waits on that and gives it an almighty crunch, straight back at the bowler. Bhuvneshwar sticks his head out of the way and gets a hand on it to deflect it over the umpire
slower ball at a length on middle stump, shuffles in the crease and pushes into the vacant leg side with soft hands
low full toss at leg stump, looks for the pick-up shot over short fine, mistimes it towards deep square
full ball at middle stump, driven down to long-on
full slower ball just outside off, drilled firmly back at the bowler
offcutter at a length on leg stump, backs away and punches on the rise to mid-off
dipping full toss outside off, backs away and looks to crunch into the off side. Gets a thick inside edge out to deep midwicket
sliced but safe. Backs into the leg side to make room and Holder follows him with a short ball. He brings out the pull but is cramped and hurried. It just clears Holder
slower short ball at leg stump, pulled to deep square

inside edge is quickly past Saha. Short of a length cutter outside off, gets deep and looks to pummel this with a pull. Thick inside edge - he's onto it too soon, and that's a bit of karma for Holder who picked up some runs like this earlier
short and slanting down leg side, swivels and looks to pull, but that kept going away
short of a length offcutter at middle stump, closes the face and jabs this into the midwicket region
"aww, no!" is Maxwell's appraisal of this. It's short and wide and he has had a cut at it and completely missed
short of a length and just outside off, hangs inside the line and opens the face to steer this to third
full and just outside off, drives with an open ace to sweeper cover
good length and curved in at off stump, gets forward and jabs towards mid-off
shot! Nothing tentative about this. Walks down at him, picks his short of a length ball, and rocks onto a half-forward stride before spanking this over midwicket from hip height. Dominant
short of a length and tight at middle stump, watchfully pushed down the pitch

top edge as Maxwell changes his mind about the pull. Short, 140kph, in the corridor. Maxwell takes his eyes off the ball after shaping to pull. And he's too late. He's taking evasive action as the ball hits the splice and lands in the vacant square-leg region
short and rising in the corridor, hangs leg side of it and stabs this down to third man
past the outside edge again. He's landing it on the seam and getting it to move away from around the wicket. Full and past the cover drive, 138kph
full and just outside off, jammed into the covers off the front foot
short and wide outside off, 145kph, mistimed aerial cut as he hurriedly hacks at this. Out towards sweeper cover
slammed in at a length outside off, 149kph, and nips away a touch to beat Padikkal's angled bat
full on off, and clipped to deep midwicket with the closed face of the bat. And guess what, he has pinched two again. Fabulous running
fuller on leg, and pushed to deep midwicket. Excellent running means he can complete two there
slogged to deep midwicket with a half-sweep-half-helicopter shot! Another full ball on middle and off, and hoicked away for four. He is dominating Rashid today
good length on middle, and clipped to the man at midwicket
crashed over long-on! Tossed up on a full length on off, and he launches a heave over the outstreched right hand of the fielder
short of a length on middle and leg, and clipped to deep square with the turn into him
hits Maxwell near his right rib, as he misses his pull to this good length ball on off
short of a length outside off, and pulled to deep midwicket for a couple
it is a full-toss just outside off. Gets it off the outside edge to third man to raise the side's fifty. Mind you, this was bowled at 153kph
pretty full on off, and that makes a good sound off the bat while landing to the man at cover. More pace here, at 151.9kph
full delivery on his pads and clipped to fine leg. Fine leg runs to his left and slides to save the boundary. And Malik touches 150kph with this
full delivery and just outside off. Pushed to cover, as Maxwell is sent back after thinking of a single. This was bowled at 147kph
very full on off, and driven to long-off
and again heaves across the line. This is full outside off, but this time Maxwell gets it off the inside half of the bat to deep midwicket
another good length ball on off, and with good bounce. Pushed back to the bowler

And Maxwell takes him on first ball! Hoicks this good length ball on off to deep midwicket. Right in the arc, as the legspinner doesn't turn. He swings in full flow playing across the line, and just clears the fence
turns into him off a good length on off. He closes the bat face for a single to deep square leg
dabs at that late to short third man and close to his body. Full ball just outside off, and he almost ran himself into trouble there by playing so late
fullish length and a touch wide of off. Pushed to point with the open face of the bat slightly away from his body

tickled behind to Saha! Good pace from Malik - at 141kph - as he bowls short of a length on leg. The ball is climbing on to the batter, as Bharat looks to pull that behind the wicket, but gets a little portion of his glove, with the ball landing to Saha's left. Malik is over the moon with that strike
again bowls fullish and just outside off, but this is at 145kph. The bat turns in Bharat's hands as he pushes that to cover
pretty full on off, and that hurries on to the batter. Nudged to cover, with Padikkal sent back after hoping for a single
fuller in length and just outside off. Just presents the full face of the bat to punch that to deep point
shortish in length and wide of off at 141kph. Padikkal looks to slash at that, but is beaten

pulled to deep midwicket! Kaul goes short and just outside off, as Bharat hangs deep in his crease to this before hammering a blow past the man at deep square leg. Ends the powerplay with two successive boundaries

chipped for six! He was expecting another slower ball - and Kaul obliged - as he lofted this full ball on off to just lift that elegantly over the bowler's head with his back leg in the air. Clean strike!
good length ball on middle, and tapped to point for a rapid run
swing and a miss! Change of pace again from Kaul to bowl a near offcutter on a good length outside off, as Padikkal loses his bottom hand while trying to hoick that to the on side
mid-on pushes an underarm throw at the bowler's end, as Bharat completes a quick single after nudging this slower ball on a fullish length on off
slower ball on a good length outside off. Bharat allows it come to him before nudging to point with the open face of the bat

another slower ball. Fuller on middle and leg, and coming into the batter. Holder appeals for leg before, but is not given. Bharat is across off while trying to flick, as the ball takes his pad to allow a leg-bye
good length ball just outside off, and cut to deep point
this again keeps low, but Padikkal stills flicks it to fine leg! On a good length on middle, and with a change of pace. Padikkal skips in the crease, and plays at that unconvincingly
slower ball on a full length on off. He opens the bat face to tap that to point
good length ball on off, and angling in. Clipped toward square leg
full and straight on off, and punched back to the bowler, who throws back to the stumps
bowls this from wide of the crease on a back of a length just outside off. Padikkal opens the bat face to guide that to point for another dot ball in the over, which ends as a wicket-maiden
slower ball again, and on a good length outside off. Pushed to point after waiting for the ball to come
chips aerially to mid-off! Slower ball on a good length just outside off, and he pushes at that
good length ball just outside off. There is not enough room for him to cut, as he cuts that off the bottom half of the bat toward cover

skies that to mid-off! So promoting Christian doesn't pay off for Royal Challengers. Another slower ball on a full length on off, as Christian plays at that early to try and loft that over the in-field, getting it off the bottom of the bat, with the ball nearly stuck in the pitch. But Williamson sits under the ball comfortably to complete the catch, and Sunrisers strike again in the powerplay
starts with a change of pace ball on a good length on middle. Christian opens the bat face to dab it to cover
another firm drive, but finds mid-off. Full ball on off in the driving length, but Padikkal can't find the gap this time
this one keeps a touch low! Pitches on a good length on middle and off, and he is surprised by the lack of bounce as he too goes low to tap at that
much fuller and wider of off. Goes for the slash after reaching out for it, but doesn't get bat on ball

makes room, and punches this past mid-off! It was a good length ball on middle, and he presents the full face of the bat to simply nudge that between the non-striker and mid-off for four. Pure timing there
lands on the bounce to third man! Looks to heave this full delivery slightly wide of off to the on side, but the ball flies off his outside edge behind the wicket instead
walks forward and across off to push that full delivery outside off, but finds cover-point
opens the bat face to dab that good length ball outside off to point
inside edge this time, but on to his back boot. This is fuller and on off, as he looks to dab at that but plays without control in the end

good length ball outside leg, as Paddikal looks to clip but misses. Williamson reviews for caught behind after a lot of consultation. Replays show the ball flicked neither bat nor either of his pads, and so Sunrisers lose a review. The ball was outside leg, and so is called wide since there was no inside edge there
slower ball, and Padikkal sends that sailingggg over midwicket! On a full length on middle and leg, and he clips to send that miles up in the air. Three fielders converge, but that still lands safely
looks to ramp this short delivery on middle, but doesn't get bat on ball. There was good bounce from Holder too
shorter in length and wide of off. Slashed to deep point away from his body! Gets it over point, as the ball rolls over to the fence last moment after third man gives the chase to his left
hits him on his front pad, as Holder bowls full on leg. Half an appeal for leg before as Padikkal is beaten on his flick, but that was always angling down

raps him on the pads, and up goes the finger! Kohli looks at his partner hoping he would signal for a review, but Padikkal says no. He looks to flick this full ball on middle while playing around his front pad and across the line, but is beaten as he closes the bat face to dispatch the ball. The ball looks to be striking flush on middle too. But replays show the ball would have clipped leg stump on umpire's call
another one on a good length on his pads, and flicks this to long leg to get off the mark
good length ball on leg, and he clips that to short fine leg, with his leg stump visible
clips this between mid-on and midwicket with the closed face of the bat by going across off to this full ball outside off
full ball on his leg stump, as it takes his pads to trickle to the keeper's left

clubs away the first ball for four! This is on a fullish length and wide of off, and angling away. Kohli stretches out to drive that to the left of mid-off with the full face of the bat, although aerially at first
